title: cellgeni/nf-cellbender samples table
description: Schema for the file provided with --samples

id.errorMessage: Sample id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

group.errorMessage: Group must start with a letter or digit, contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', and not be 'index' or 'versions.yml'

path.errorMessage: Path must be provided and cannot contain spaces

cells.errorMessage: cells must be a whole number of at least 1, or empty

droplets.errorMessage: droplets must be a whole number of at least 1, or empty

min_umi.errorMessage: min_umi must be a whole number of at least 0, or empty

exclude_features.pattern: ^\s*(All|Antibody Capture|CRISPR Guide Capture|Custom|Peaks|Multiplexing Capture|VDJ|VDJ\-T|VDJ\-T\-GD|VDJ\-B|Antigen Capture)\s*(,\s*(Antibody Capture|CRISPR Guide Capture|Custom|Peaks|Multiplexing Capture|VDJ|VDJ\-T|VDJ\-T\-GD|VDJ\-B|Antigen Capture)\s*)*$
exclude_features.errorMessage: exclude_features takes a comma-separated list of: Antibody Capture, CRISPR Guide Capture, Custom, Peaks, Multiplexing Capture, VDJ, VDJ-T, VDJ-T-GD, VDJ-B, Antigen Capture (CellBender 0.3), or All (CellBender 0.2)
